description: Only what changed in one recorded signal since THIS wallet last paid for it ($0.001 USDC, the cheapest call here). Use when you check the same signal again and again: the server keeps your cursor, so you never re-download what you already have. Needs signal= (e.g. sentiment, funding-rates, volatility); the first call returns the last 24h. Not for a one-off question: call the signal tool itself.

payment.description: Optional. Base64 x402 payment payload you signed yourself (ERC-3009 TransferWithAuthorization, USDC on Base). Call without it once to receive the payment requirements, sign those, then call again with this argument. This server forwards the payload and never holds a key.

signal.description: sentiment, funding-rates, liquidation-levels, volatility, correlation, positioning, supply, stablecoin-health, macro-onchain, defi-yields, dex-vs-cex, arbitrage-opportunities, funding-predictions

name: get_changes_since_last_call
